name: adult blue dragon
desc: Adult Blue Dragon is a CR 16 dragon.

actions.name: multiattack
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can use its [[/item .xWSOEwthNmDecfQ8]]{Frightful Presence}. It then makes three attacks: one with its [[/item .tz3vYeFf3GLouPGC]]{bite} and two with its [[/item .kYySllKlNPBsT7Ho]]{claws}.

actions.name: legendary resistance
actions.desc: If the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

actions.name: frightful presence
actions.desc: Each creature of the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}'s choice that is within [[lookup @labels.description.range activity=2VOmvThI0bGdUsMt]] of the dragon and aware of it must succeed on a [[/save]] saving throw or become &Reference[frightened] for [[lookup @labels.duration activity=2VOmvThI0bGdUsMt]]. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}'s [[lookup @item.name]] for the next 24 hours.

actions.name: lightning breath
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} exhales lightning in a [[lookup @labels.description.template activity=GSQtl90Opu6WzZk4]]. Each creature in that line must make a [[/save]] saving throw, taking [[/damage average]] damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

actions.name: detect
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} makes a Wisdom (Perception) check.

actions.name: wing attack
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} beats its wings. Each creature within [[lookup @labels.description.range activity=4U3711rd7WmlJIhy]] of the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} must succeed on a [[/save]] saving throw or take [[/damage average]] damage and be knocked &Reference[prone]. The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can then fly up to half its flying speed.
